site.name: Feudal League
site.tagline: Leagues, tournaments and match analysis for Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition

site.source: Rating and match data come from the game's own servers and may lag by a few minutes.

home.title: Your AoE2 matches become a league.
home.subtitle: Matches stay in the game, ranked or lobby. The portal reads the history, places everyone in the division of their rating and compares you with people at your level. Create the league of your clan, Discord or city.

add.title: Add a player
add.hint: Paste a Steam profile link, a SteamID64, an AoE2 profile_id or the exact in-game nickname.
add.free: No account needed. Anyone can add anyone.

one.title: Add
one.text: Paste a Steam link or nickname. The portal starts tracking the rating on every ladder.

two.title: Join your bracket
two.text: Leagues have rating divisions, from Shield to Crown. If you're at 900, you compete with people at 900.

three.title: Play in AoE2
three.text: Matches happen in the game itself, ranked or lobby. Results enter the table from the history, no screenshots.

leagues.title: Leagues
leagues.intro: A league groups players into divisions by rating band. Your band is set by your peak RM 1v1 rating and stays frozen until the season ends. Within a division, a win is worth 3 points and a loss 1.
leagues.globalHint: Open to everyone. Join and show up in your band's table.
leagues.createHint: Your crew, your Discord, your city. You set the bands.
leagues.loginToCreate: Sign in with Steam to create a league.
leagues.empty: No leagues besides the global one yet.
leagues.noMatches: No matches between members yet. Play a 1v1 and it shows up here on the next sync.

join.preview: You'll enter the {division} division with rating {rating}.
join.login: Sign in with Steam to join.
join.no_rating: You don't have an RM 1v1 rating yet. Play ranked 1v1 games and come back.
join.few_games: Not enough ranked 1v1 games: you have {games} and the league requires {min}. This keeps new accounts out of the wrong band.
join.no_division: No division covers rating {rating} in this league.
join.no_season: This league has no open season.

rules.title: How it works
rules.placement: Your division is set by your all-time peak RM 1v1 rating, not your current one. If you've been high, you can't enter a low band.
rules.detect: Any 1v1 between two members of the same division counts automatically: ranked or lobby, no reporting.
rules.detectLobby: Only lobby games between two members of the same division count. Ranked games are excluded.
rules.points: Win {win} points, loss {loss}. Tiebreaks: wins, then fewer losses, then rating.
rules.season: Your division stays frozen until the season ends. Then everyone is re-placed by their current rating.
rules.detectNonMembers: Your ranked 1v1 against any player rated within your bracket counts, in the league or not. Between members of the same division, lobby counts too.
rules.autoJoin: Whoever plays against a member is brought into the league and placed in their bracket by peak rating.
rules.claimJoin: Claiming your profile joins this league automatically. You can leave any time.

analysis.title: Match feedback
analysis.intro: The portal downloads the official recorded game, summarizes what each player did and asks a language model for feedback aimed at you.
analysis.requestHint: Free. You can still request {n} today.
analysis.limitReached: You have used today's {n} analyses. Come back tomorrow.
analysis.ownerOnly: Only the person who claimed this profile can request an analysis of this match.
analysis.login: Sign in with Steam to request
analysis.processing: Takes under a minute. This page refreshes itself.
analysis.failed: This match could not be analyzed.
analysis.failedReplay: The recording is no longer available on the game server. Only recent matches have one.

err.not_member: That player did not take part in this match.
err.not_owner: Only the profile owner can request the analysis.

analysis.disclaimer: The recording stores commands, not game state. Timings and decisions are exact; resources in stock and idle villagers are inferences.

donate.title: Liked it? This service is free and costs money to run.
donate.text: Every analysis calls a language model API. If you want to help keep the project running, donations are optional.

tournaments.title: Tournaments
tournaments.intro: Knockout with or without a group stage, teams of 1 to 4, best of 1, 3 or 5. Results confirm themselves when the match shows up in the players' history.
